2150. Checking Divisibility by 3 and 5 Using a Function

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it is divisible by both 3 and 5, using a function that returns 1 or 0.

Description
Read an integer num from input. Write a function isDivisible that takes one integer parameter and returns 1 if the number is divisible by both 3 and 5, and returns 0 otherwise. In main(), call the function and use an if-else statement on the returned value to print "Divisible" or "Not Divisible".
input_spec:
. Write a function isDivisible that takes one integer parameter and returns 1 if the number is divisible by both 3 and 5, and returns 0 otherwise. In main(), call the function and use an if-else statement on the returned value to print "Divisible" or "Not Divisible".

Input Description
A single positive integer num.
output_spec: Print "Divisible" if num is divisible by both 3 and 5, otherwise print "Not Divisible".
